statement: For 4 oscillators with generic frequencies and generic nonzero symmetric complete-graph couplings, the complex solution count after fixing one phase is the normalized lattice volume of conv{±(e_i-e_j): 0≤i<j≤3}, with e_0=0.

source.location: Theorem 3.5, PDF p. 7; Corollary 3.6, PDF p. 9

origin.inheritance_basis: Apply the theorem to the complete graph on 4 vertices, with one vertex fixed as the reference phase.
